jobs.title: Embedded Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description: At DeWarmte, we develop technology that helps homes move away from gas. Our heat pumps combine hardware, embedded control software, cloud services and data – and the quality of the software connecting those elements directly determines how well our products perform in customers’ homes. We are looking for an experienced Embedded Controls Software Engineer to develop and evolve the software that operates our heat pumps and, increasingly, a broader range of connected energy devices. As part of our Control & Data team, you will work directly on production software, refine control algorithms, improve product performance and help shape the next generation of our embedded software platform. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software, hardware, control engineering and energy systems. You will work on technology that is already operating in customers’ homes while building the technical foundations for future products and use cases. Your mission Build reliable, efficient and extensible control software that enables our products to operate intelligently in an increasingly connected and flexible energy system. You will inherit working software already deployed in the field. Your job is to understand it deeply, maintain and improve it, and progressively evolve its architecture to support new products, control strategies and regulatory requirements. Together with the Lead Controls & Data Engineer and our Hardware R&D team, you will help build an embedded software platform that can scale with DeWarmte’s ambitions. What you will do Maintain and improve our control software Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps. Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality. Develop, refine and validate control algorithms to improve product performance, stability, safety, energy efficiency and customer comfort. Use operational data and real-world measurements to understand product behaviour and identify opportunities for improvement. Di

jobs.title: Head of Operational Integration
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.title: Computational Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT We are a special projects team within Proxima’s engineering organisation, using software and computation to fundamentally change how complex machines are designed and built. We take on problems where a small team can deliver a step change in capability, with the goal of getting a stellarator connected to the grid as fast as possible. As a Computational Engineer, you will bring together mechanical engineering experience and strong software development skills. jobs.title: AI Engineer (Manipulation) H/F
jobs.description: At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on manipulation , you will develop the models that let the Marso robot pick, handle and place real-world loads reliably in customer warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of manipulation models from data collection and training to on-robot evaluation and production deployment. Responsibilities Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot. Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models. Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs. Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams. Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments. Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints). Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap. Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance. Profile 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation. Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent). Practical experience with at least one of: imitation learning, reinforcement learning or vision-language-action models for manipulation. Experience deploying models on real robots, including under hardware constraints. Solid understanding of manipulation fundamentals: kinematics, grasping, motion planning and control. Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, C++, physics simulators, teleoperation setups, force/torque sensing or logistics applications such as palletization or depalletization. jobs.title: AI Engineer (Perception) H/F
jobs.description: At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on perception , you will develop the models that let the Marso robot understand its environment: detecting, locating and tracking loads, obstacles and people in warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of perception models from data quality and training to production reliability. Responsibilities Develop, train and evaluate embedded perception models: object detection, segmentation, pose estimation and scene understanding. Fuse data from multiple sensors (cameras, depth sensors, lidar, IMU) to deliver robust perception in real operating conditions. Define and measure data quality for perception and automate dataset extraction and labeling from field logs. Make sure models stay reliable through every deployment stage from PoCs and field tests to production, including changes in lighting, loads and sites. Optimize models for embedded hardware to meet latency and compute constraints while maintaining the output quality. Set up standardized evaluation and regression testing so that every model release is measurably better. Build internal tools to visualize and debug sensor data, predictions and model performance. Profile 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering focused on computer vision or 3D perception, ideally in robotics or autonomous systems. Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent). Hands-on experience with 2D and 3D perception: detection, segmentation, pose estimation, point clouds or multi-sensor fusion. Experience deploying perception models to production under hardware constraints. Solid understanding of data pipelines: collection, cleaning, labeling and quality measurement. Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, camera and lidar calibration, synthetic data generation, C++ or perception for logistics environments. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. Chez Marso, en tant qu' AI Engine

You will make sure the robot's software is reliable, safe, maintainable and ready to scale to a growing fleet. Turn the system requirements and the integrated technical roadmap into a software architecture, working with Product & Systems and the CTO. Set and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, design reviews, testing strategy and documentation. Design how AI models from Intelligent Robotics are integrated, deployed and monitored on the robot. Own software reliability and safety: fault handling, watchdogs, diagnostics, logging and contributions to safety analyses. Participate in defining the build, release and deployment chain for embedded software (CI/CD, versioning, over-the-air updates, fleet configuration). Expert in embedded Linux with solid experience in real-time systems. Hands-on experience with robotics middleware and multi-process architectures. Experience integrating sensors, actuators and compute platforms. Strong knowledge of software quality and reliability practices: testing, CI/CD, observability and fault handling. jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we’re hiring We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field. This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies. You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench. No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side. Responsibilities and Duties Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling. Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end. Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it. Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. jobs.title: IT-Administrator Schwerpunkt Security (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Codewerk steht für Technikbegeisterung, Innovation und Zuverlässigkeit mit flachen Hierarchien, Freiraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Ob in Zügen oder Industrieanlagen – wir bringen die Systeme von morgen dazu, miteinander zu reden. Für den weiteren Unternehmensaufbau brauchen wir Deine Hilfe! In Deiner Rolle arbeitest Du eng mit der Unternehmensleitung zusammen und bringst Dein Team und Codewerk in Sachen IT & Security auf das nächste Level. Sei aktiv am Wachstum der Codewerk GmbH beteiligt und starte in Karlsruhe oder Berlin mit uns durch! Deine Aufgaben: Als Teil des IT-Admin-Teams übernimmst du Verantwortung die Weiterentwicklung unsere IT-Governance-, Compliance- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien und deren Umsetzung im Unternehmen. Dabei evaluierst Du neue Systeme anhand verschiedener Aspekte wie Funktionalität, Sicherheit oder Wartungsaufwand und gestaltest unsere IT-Sicherheitslandschaft aktiv mit Von IT-Notfallkonzepten, Audits und Sicherheitsrichtlinien bis hin zur Einführung moderner Sicherheitslösungen wie Zero Trust, MDM und MFA – Du betreust und steuerst unsere IT-Projekte von Anfang an mit. Für unsere hybriden IT-Umgebungen entwickelst Du durchdachte Sicherheitskonzepte und verbindest Netzwerk-, Identity- und Access-Strategien zu einer ganzheitlichen Architektur. Externe Dienstleister nutzt Du als Partner, um Deine Projekte schnell und effektiv voranzubringen. Du bist kompetenter Ansprechpartner bei Problemen: Als Software-Dienstleister bieten wir Dir ein Umfeld, in dem Dein Team den Drucker selbst installieren kann - Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge nicht nur „zum Laufen bringt“, sondern sie wirklich im Griff hat. Wir bauen auf Dein Wissen und Du gibst Dein Wissen gerne an andere Mitarbeiter weiter. Diese Basis bringst Du auf jeden Fall mit: Interesse an neuen Technologien: Egal ob Docker, Kubernetes, vCenter, Proxmox – Du bleibst technisch immer auf dem neuesten Stand und verfolgst aktiv aktuelle Entwicklungen in der IT. jobs.description: As a Solution Architect , you develop and improve end-to-end solutions for customers in the defence and security sectors. You translate their requirements into viable solution concepts and work with Sales, Product Management and Engineering to assess how unmanned platforms, software and existing customer systems can be integrated into a reliable solution. You bring your own area of expertise to the role, combining an understanding of customer needs with sound technical judgement and considering feasibility, implementation and ongoing operations. You contribute the solution concept to the proposal and support its handover to the implementation teams. Depending on your area of focus, you may work on use cases such as reconnaissance, surveillance, counter-UAS (C-UAS) or other cross-domain applications. You combine the customer’s perspective with technical expertise and work with our specialists to define how the components work together and how the solution integrates with existing customer systems. You account for relevant military requirements and support implementation. You work with Product Management and Engineering to compare solution options against feasibility, integration effort and other agreed criteria. Together with Sales and Bid Management, you prepare the technical content for proposals. You lead technical discussions and workshops with customers, end users, government authorities and integration partners. You clarify requirements and operating conditions and work with them to define how the solution will be used in practice in a Concept of Operations (ConOps). You document the solution concept, how its components work together and the key architecture decisions so that customers and implementation teams can use them. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step.
